output_list.code: function TokenERC20(uint256 initialSupply, string tokenName, string tokenSymbol) public { totalSupply = initialSupply * 10 ** uint256(decimals); balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply; name = tokenName; symbol = tokenSymbol; }
output_list.reason: The initialSupply is multiplied by 10 ** uint256(decimals) to get the totalSupply. This can cause an integer overflow if initialSupply is too large. The totalSupply is then assigned to the balanceOf mapping of the contract owner. This can lead to a loss of funds if the contract owner has a large initialSupply.

The balanceOf[_to] += _value; line can also cause an integer overflow if the balance of _to is too large.
